in_sanskrit.name: तुकाराम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: तु काराम् (tu kārām) - तु (tu) meaning 'self' and काराम् (kārām) meaning 'contentment'

in_hindi.name: तुकाराम
in_hindi.long_meaning: तु (tu) + काराम (kārām) = तुकाराम (tukārām) - तु (tu) meaning 'self' and काराम (kārām) meaning 'contentment'

in_tamil.name: துகரம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: து (du) + கரம் (karam) = துகரம் (dugaram) - து (du) meaning 'self' and கரம் (karam) meaning 'contentment'

in_telugu.name: తుగరామ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: తు (tu) + గరామ్ (garām) = తుగరామ్ (tugarām) - తు (tu) meaning 'self' and గరామ్ (garām) meaning 'contentment'

in_marathi.name: Tukaram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tukaram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tu meaning 'God' and Kara meaning 'God of Gods'.

in_bengali.name: Tukaram
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Gods
in_bengali.long_meaning: Tukaram একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Tu meaning 'God' and Kara meaning 'God of Gods'.
